verses.pali: “Dveme, bhikkhave, dhammā saddhammassa sammosāya antaradhānāya saṁvattanti.
verses.english: “These two things, mendicants, lead to the decline and disappearance of the true teaching.
The words and phrases are misplaced, and the meaning is misinterpreted.

verses.pali: Dunnikkhittassa, bhikkhave, padabyañjanassa atthopi dunnayo hoti.
verses.english: When the words and phrases are misplaced, the meaning is misinterpreted.

verses.pali: Ime kho, bhikkhave, dve dhammā saddhammassa sammosāya antaradhānāya saṁvattantī”ti.
verses.english: These two things lead to the decline and disappearance of the true teaching.

verses.pali: “Dveme, bhikkhave, dhammā saddhammassa ṭhitiyā asammosāya anantaradhānāya saṁvattanti.
verses.english: These two things lead to the continuation, persistence, and enduring of the true teaching.
The words and phrases are well organized, and the meaning is correctly interpreted.

verses.pali: Sunikkhittassa, bhikkhave, padabyañjanassa atthopi sunayo hoti.
verses.english: When the words and phrases are well organized, the meaning is correctly interpreted.

verses.pali: Ime kho, bhikkhave, dve dhammā saddhammassa ṭhitiyā asammosāya anantaradhānāya saṁvattantī”ti.
verses.english: These two things lead to the continuation, persistence, and enduring of the true teaching.”
